name: Avatares AI - API - List Review Candidates

parameters.query:
SELECT
  asset_id,
  avatar,
  asset_type,
  scene,
  version,
  bucket,
  object_path,
  original_filename,
  mime_type,
  file_size,
  extension,
  sha256,
  status,
  is_canonical,
  canonical_group,
  review_notes,
  created_at
FROM canonical_asset_registry
WHERE avatar = '{{ $("Normalize Request").first().json.avatar }}'
  AND scene = '{{ $("Normalize Request").first().json.scene }}'
  AND asset_type = '{{ $("Normalize Request").first().json.assetType }}'
  AND (
    status IN ('raw', 'selected')
    OR (
      {{ $("Normalize Request").first().json.includeCanonical }}
      AND status = 'canonical'
    )
  )
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT {{ $("Normalize Request").first().json.limit }};
